definitions.de: Glauben; etwas für wahr halten oder jemandem vertrauen
definitions.en: To believe; to accept something as true or to trust someone
definitions.es: Creer; aceptar algo como verdadero o confiar en alguien
definitions.fr: Croire ; accepter quelque chose comme vrai ou faire confiance à quelqu'un
definitions.hi: विश्वास करना; किसी बात को सच मानना या किसी पर भरोसा करना
definitions.ja: 信じる；何かを真実として受け入れる、または誰かを信頼する
definitions.km: ជឿ; ទទួលយកអ្វីមួយថាជាការពិត ឬទុកចិត្តលើអ្នកណាម្នាក់
definitions.ko: 믿다; 무언가를 사실로 받아들이거나 누군가를 신뢰하다
definitions.ne: विश्वास गर्नु; कुनै कुरा सत्य मान्नु वा कसैलाई भरोसा गर्नु
definitions.pt: Acreditar; aceitar algo como verdadeiro ou confiar em alguém
definitions.th: เชื่อ; ยอมรับบางสิ่งว่าเป็นความจริง หรือไว้วางใจบางคน
definitions.tl: Maniwala; tanggapin ang isang bagay bilang totoo o magtiwala sa isang tao
definitions.ur: یقین کرنا؛ کسی بات کو سچ ماننا یا کسی پر بھروسہ کرنا
definitions.vi: Tin; chấp nhận điều gì đó là thật hoặc tin tưởng vào ai đó
definitions.zh: 相信；认为某事是真的，或信任某人
definitions.zh_Hant: 相信；認為某事是真的，或信任某人

definition_en: To believe; to accept something as true or to trust someone

lao_examples.lao_script: ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ເຊື່ອວ່າລາວເວົ້າຄວາມຈິງ
lao_examples.romanization: khoi bo sɯa waa lao wao khwam-sing
lao_examples.translation_en: I don't believe that he/she is telling the truth.

lao_examples.lao_script: ເຊື່ອຂ້ອຍເດີ, ອາຫານຮ້ານນີ້ແຊບຫຼາຍ
lao_examples.romanization: sɯa khoi doe, aa-haan haan nii saep laai
lao_examples.translation_en: Believe me, the food at this restaurant is really delicious.
